title: Sportraxs — RMB | UTCT 2026, UTCT 100M official final leaderboard
publisher: Sportraxs (official timing platform linked from RMB Ultra-trail Cape Town)
claims: At 14:25 SAST on 22 November 2026 the official Sportraxs UTCT 100M leaderboard was headed 'Official results' and 'Finished · official', listing 127 runners: 91 finished, 36 withdrawn and 0 on course.
The final overall top five were Aleksei Tolstenko in 21:32:48, Pieter de Wortelaer in 23:05:12, Careth Arnold in 23:53:08, and a tie for fourth at 24:06:46 between Mark Winter and Matthew Thomson.
The final women's top three were Careth Arnold in 23:53:08 (also third overall), Magdalena Kraszpulska in 25:11:23 and Kerry-Ann Marshall in 25:36:36.
The final field was 101 men (72 finished, 29 withdrawn) and 26 women (19 finished, 7 withdrawn), all 127 settled with none on course.

The Sportraxs UTCT 100M event card displays 161 km and 9,004 m of gain, 91 finishers and 36 withdrawals; this is a fifth distance-and-gain pair and is not averaged with the official page's 163 km / 7,187 m or 7,516 m.

The 11:19 SAST provisional count of 127 runners, 75 finished, 36 withdrawn and 16 on course resolved to 91 finished, 36 withdrawn and 0 on course: all 16 on-course runners were settled, withdrawals did not change.
